subtests.name: windowFeatures IDL attribute reflects the windowfeatures content attribute on a, area, and form
<a windowfeatures="split"> sets BarProp visibility to true
<a windowfeatures="popup"> sets BarProp visibility to false
<a windowfeatures="split, popup"> sets BarProp visibility to false (popup fallback)
<a windowfeatures="width=400, height=300"> does not trigger the legacy popup heuristic
<a windowfeatures="toolbar=0, menubar=0"> ignores disallowed legacy features
<a windowfeatures="split"> targeting an existing named frame navigates that frame
